title: AIR: Rethinking Image-Text Offset Alignment in Multimodal Contrastive Representation Space
abstract: arXiv:2506.10895v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image-text offset alignment, which refers to the consistency between visual transformation directions and their corresponding textual transformation directions, has become an important relational property in multimodal contrastive representation spaces such as CLIP and SigLIP. This property plays a central role in text-driven visual transformation tasks, including generative model domain adaptation and text-guided object-centric image editing, where textual offsets are used to guide visual transformations. These methods fundamentally rely on the assumption that image and text offsets are well aligned, such that textual transformation directions can provide reliable guidance for corresponding visual transformations. However, the validity of this alignment assumption has not been systematically examined. translated_title: AIR：重新思考多模态对比表征空间中的图文偏移对齐
translated_abstract: 图文偏移对齐（image-text offset alignment）是指视觉变换方向与其对应文本变换方向之间的一致性，它已成为 CLIP 和 SigLIP 等多模态对比表征空间中的一个重要关系属性。该属性在文本驱动的视觉变换任务中发挥着核心作用，包括生成模型的领域自适应和文本引导的对象中心图像编辑等，在这些任务中，文本偏移被用于引导视觉变换。这些方法从根本上依赖于一个假设，即图像偏移与文本偏移是良好对齐的，从而使文本变换方向能够为相应的视觉变换提供可靠的指导。然而，这一对齐假设的有效性尚未得到系统性检验。在本工作中，我们通过对图文偏移对齐进行全面的实证分析，对这一基础性假设提出了质疑。
tldr: 本文系统性地实证检验了 CLIP、SigLIP 等多模态对比表征空间中文本驱动的视觉变换方法所依赖的“图文偏移对齐”假设，质疑其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a comprehensive empirical analysis to question the foundational assumption of image-text offset alignment in multimodal contrastive representation spaces like CLIP and SigLIP, which underpins text-driven visual transformation tasks.
